## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: sharing the road
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical guide page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The truck acceleration paragraph credits a third-party publication; only the guide's own restatement was used, in original words [A02].
The car stopping distance line prints two numbers side by side without a separator; it was read as a range of roughly one hundred thirty to one hundred forty feet [A02] (verify MO-SHARE-D-STOPDIST).
The No-Zone paragraph refers to a picture with no extractable text; only the written description of the blind spots was used [A02].
The electric bicycle definition and classes cite a state statute and were summarized rather than copied [A06].
The road-rage reporting number and the littering penalty are isolated as dynamic facts [A07].
The motorcycle helmet requirement is stated as a general rule on the motorcycle page with no exceptions given; no exceptions were added [A01].

corpus_stability.reason: The Missouri Driver Guide prints a single edition line on its front cover (Revised August 2026); its table-of-contents note says law and policy changes may make parts out of date and points to the website for the current version, with no sign in the selected pages of more than one rewrite per year.

verification_debt.claim_text: Physical page 31 prints the average car stopping distance at highway speed as two numbers next to each other with no dash; the range reading must be confirmed on the rendered page before the exact figures are taught.
